verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at app.pipelinecrm.com that describes the Pipeline CRM REST API. A marketing-site llms.txt also indexes the API docs and feature pages, and a machine-readable openapi.json is served, so an agent has clear entry points. missing for 10: independent or hands-on evidence of agents using these docs successfully, and visibility into the full depth of the llms.txt content (the probe excerpt is truncated).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
